rights-holder.description: Official designer, label, collaborator, or corporate pages.
rights-holder.attribution: Link to the specific official page and identify the organization or creator.
rights-holder.licensing_position: A public page supports citation only; it does not grant permission to copy text, images, video, or structured data.
rights-holder.reliability: Primary for the rights holder's own credits and announcements; potentially promotional and not automatically independent.
rights-holder.rate_limits: Not evaluated for automation. Respect published robots, API, and terms requirements before any machine access.
rights-holder.retention: Store the URL and short original archive summary; do not mirror page content or media.

cultural-institution.description: Museum, gallery, and public cultural-heritage sources.
cultural-institution.attribution: Name the institution and link to the object, exhibition, or research page.
cultural-institution.access_method: Human-reviewed public collection or research page citation.
cultural-institution.licensing_position: Institutional access and open-access policies vary by object and asset; verify the item-level rights statement before reuse.
cultural-institution.reliability: Strong for catalog records and institutional research; dates and attributions can still be revised.
cultural-institution.rate_limits: No automated access is approved. A documented API and its current terms are required first.
cultural-institution.retention: Store citation metadata only unless an item-specific license authorizes additional material.

editorial-publication.description: Established fashion, culture, business, and news publications.
editorial-publication.attribution: Name the publication, preserve the article or show-page URL, and write an original concise summary.
editorial-publication.access_method: Human-reviewed public webpage citation; no paywall circumvention.
editorial-publication.licensing_position: Copyright remains with the publication or its licensors. Citation does not authorize copying editorial text, photography, or datasets.
editorial-publication.reliability: Useful secondary reporting and runway documentation; corroborate disputed or consequential claims.
editorial-publication.rate_limits: Automation is prohibited until written terms, robots directives, and any licensed API limits are reviewed.
editorial-publication.retention: Store URL, title, notes, and original archive facts; do not reproduce articles or images.

independent-research.description: Independent fashion research, criticism, and specialist project pages.
independent-research.attribution: Identify the author or project where available and retain the exact page URL.
independent-research.licensing_position: Assume ordinary copyright unless the page provides a specific reusable license.
independent-research.reliability: Potentially valuable specialist interpretation; corroborate identity, dates, and formal credits with primary or institutional evidence.
independent-research.retention: Store citation metadata and original archive summaries only.

general-reference.description: General collaborative reference used for narrow identity disambiguation.
general-reference.attribution: Link the exact article and prefer its underlying citations for important claims.
general-reference.licensing_position: Reuse depends on the page's stated Creative Commons terms and attribution requirements; Trainspotting currently links rather than republishes.
general-reference.reliability: Tertiary and editable; acceptable as supporting evidence, not the sole authority for contested claims.
general-reference.rate_limits: No automated import is approved; any future use must follow Wikimedia API etiquette and current terms.
general-reference.retention: Store the URL and independently written archive metadata only.

video-platform.description: YouTube and Vimeo video identifiers displayed through platform-supported embeds.
video-platform.attribution: Identify the channel or rights holder where known and retain the platform video ID.
video-platform.access_method: Human-selected video ID and platform-supported playback.
video-platform.licensing_position: Availability on YouTube or Vimeo does not authorize downloading, rehosting, or extracting audiovisual content.
video-platform.reliability: Useful audiovisual evidence; uploader identity, edits, and availability require review.
video-platform.rate_limits: No platform API use is approved. Future API access requires reviewed credentials, quotas, and current developer-policy compliance.
video-platform.retention: Store only the video ID and related archive metadata.

community-evidence.description: HTTP(S) evidence proposed by authenticated Trainspotting members.
community-evidence.attribution: Preserve the submitted URL, optional title and notes, submitter, reviewer, and decision history.
community-evidence.access_method: Authenticated submission followed by moderator or administrator review.
community-evidence.licensing_position: A submitted URL is evidence, not a license. Reviewers must reject copied material or unsafe reuse claims.
community-evidence.reliability: Unknown until reviewed; approval records the decision but does not convert the source into an unquestionable authority.
community-evidence.rate_limits: Submission APIs are rate limited. Trainspotting does not fetch or crawl submitted URLs automatically.
community-evidence.retention: Retain source metadata and append-only review history according to the moderation and backup policy.
community-evidence.review_owner: Moderator for review; administrator for canonical promotion and rollback
